table.name: Has_Pet
table.purpose: Junction/association table linking students to their pets. Each row records that a student (col_001) owns a particular pet (col_002). A student can own multiple pets (e.g., student 1002 owns pets 2002 and 2003).

col_001.name: student_id
col_001.description: Identifier of the student who owns the pet. References Student.col_001 (many-to-one); the lookup shows Student.col_001 maps to student surnames (e.g., 1004 -> Kumar, 1018 -> Leighton).

col_002.name: pet_id
col_002.description: Identifier of the pet owned by the student. Marked as primary key here, but given the table name 'Has_Pet' and the sibling table 'Pets', this is almost certainly a reference to Pets' identifier. No accepted join was detected (likely due to the tiny sample), so the link to Pets is inferred from table names rather than observed joins.

table.name: Pets
table.purpose: A lookup table of pets, each row one pet with a unique id, species, an age, and a weight. Referenced by Has_Pet, which links students to pets.

col_001.name: pet_id
col_001.description: Primary key identifying each pet; unique integer ids (2001-2003).

col_003.name: age
col_003.description: Pet age in years (small integers 1-3). Could alternatively be an ordinal, but age is the natural reading.

col_004.name: weight
col_004.description: Pet weight, presumably in kilograms (values 9.3-13.4). Unit not confirmed; could be pounds.

table.name: Student
table.purpose: One row per student: identity, age, sex, advisor, major and home city code. Referenced by Has_Pet, which links students to their pets.

col_001.name: student_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique student identifier (1001-1035). Referenced by Has_Pet.col_001.

col_002.name: last_name
col_002.description: Student's surname/family name (e.g. Kumar, Leighton, Woods).

col_005.name: sex
col_005.description: Sex code: M = male (24), F = female (10).

col_006.name: major_code
col_006.description: Code for the student's major/department (values 50, 100, 520, 540, 550, 600; 600 most common). No lookup table present, so the exact meaning of each code is unresolved.

col_008.name: home_city_code
col_008.description: Three-letter city code (NYC, PIT, CHI, HKG, ATL, HOU, PHL, BAL...). Likely home/hometown city; could alternatively be campus or birth city.
